decisions: Reuse existing structural/model/corpus/evidence owners; proposed joinedcatalog is derived discovery/planning only.
Preserve cohort-bound 8D inference; add separately versioned batched/resident inventory inference and sealed shards.
8D feature reconstruction is current; 384D source-conditioned semantic decoding remains proposed and uses an independently selected latent width/update protocol.
Freeze source, instruction, model/off identity, domains, keys, evidence, query pages/frontier, operations and optional lake snapshot in one planning generation.
Exact proof eligibility follows source correspondence, full keys, assumption/domain policy and evidence custody, not retrieval similarity or CID byte integrity alone.
Current local parallel/indexed optimizations default on with opt-outs; public integration, remote delivery and collectives remain unqualified.
Next crossing is current requirement/property matching through independent admission, native edit and rechecked/rematched successor; model-off is the control.
identity_scope: Selected ending per-file observations in a concurrently edited workspace; not an atomic checkout capture, transitive environment attestation or rerun of retained experiments.
